verdict.rationale: Splitting a sale across payment methods or payers is a fair question for a payments/POS product like Square, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions split tender, partial payments against one order, or splitting a bill between payers. The pack only covers general payment acceptance (Tap to Pay, the Mobile Payments SDK, the Terminal API, a single payments.create call) and order management, none of which documents this capability.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can split a single sale across multiple payment methods or payers
